assertions.rubric: Does every screen mockup say 'mockup, not functional' at the top, carry a one-line accessibility note (heading level, landmarks, keyboard entry point) that claims no conformance, use no script or network resource, and link each action in the edge's words?

Does the agent reuse the design system and the WCAG 2.2 AA target from AGENTS.md without asking about them, ask at most one content question for the phrase-only idea, record the other choices as (guess) or open questions, and run validate before showing the mockups?
Does the confirm-by-email screen added on 'Refine' get its own mockup, and does the editor's journey reuse a screen ID wherever it shows the same screen as the reader's?
